tests: A main text column with three independent sidebars positioned alongside it, each with its own bold lead-in.
attacks: Reading order interleaving. Geometry alone will slot each sidebar between main-column paragraphs at whatever vertical position it sits, breaking the main argument into fragments. The bold sidebar lead-ins are also strong candidates for false heading promotion.
title: Storage Policy
readingOrderNote: The main column must stay contiguous. Sidebars are supplementary and belong after it, or clearly delimited as asides — not interleaved between main-column paragraphs.
intentionalProblems: three sidebars competing with main-column reading order
bold lead-ins that are not headings
